name: Barbell Thruster
instructions: Hold a barbell in the front rack position across your shoulders, elbows high, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive up out of the squat and use that momentum to press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders and go straight into the next squat.
image_prompt_scene: Standing with the barbell in the front rack position.
